name: Kutchan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kutchan town emblem in navy: a stylised mountain silhouette within angular brackets, forming a stylised letter K.
history: Municipal flag of Kutchan, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 July 1991.

features.role: Kutchan town emblem — a stylised mountain silhouette within angular brackets, forming a stylised letter K
